glossary.definition:
Function

A special relation in which every value of x has one, and only one, value of y.

The animation will stay paused when you close. Use Resume to continue.

Close

Relation

A set of ordered pairs. Relations can be expressed using words, tables, lists of ordered pairs, graphs, or an algebraic rule or equation.

The animation will stay paused when you close. Use Resume to continue.

Close

Value

This is what something is worth in terms of something else. In math, value refers to the size expressed by a number. For example: the value of 4 is four units, four things or objects.

The animation will stay paused when you close. Use Resume to continue.

Close
